policies.title: Three-way matching
policies.text: Before a payment recommendation, invoice quantities and prices must agree with an approved purchase order. Billed quantities must be supported by receiving or service-acceptance records. A short delivery remains on hold until additional evidence arrives or the supplier corrects the invoice. No automatic tolerance is allowed in this prototype.

policies.title: Vendor bank changes
policies.text: A bank account suffix on an invoice that differs from the approved vendor master requires independent verification using an existing trusted vendor contact and a separately authorized vendor-master update. The invoice itself is not sufficient evidence to approve the change. Do not call new contact details printed only on the changed invoice.

policies.title: Duplicate payment prevention
policies.text: An invoice with the same normalized invoice number and vendor as an already paid or pending payment must be held for review. A plausible duplicate is not a determination of fraud. No second payment may be recommended until the conflict has been resolved outside this prototype.

policies.title: Evidence and reviewer authority
policies.text: A recommendation requires complete source references and an identified human reviewer. Missing evidence cannot be treated as a pass. An agent or reviewer note cannot override a failed control. Approval of a review pack is a recommendation only; this prototype never posts a journal entry, updates a vendor master, sends an email, or initiates a payment.
